messages:
Cam (People Ops): Short thread 1: we're publishing a micro-update to the handbook: 'Manager attestation & schedule-exception flow'. Need two quick reviewers for wording and one person to run the RSVP + completion exports. Goal: publish by 2026-06-01 and capture manager ack receipts automatically.

Zara: I can do wording review. Are contractors included?

Cam (People Ops): Contractors are excluded from paid-benefit language; theyre asked to follow the attestation process if they manage >3 FTEs, but mark as 'recommended'. Legal will confirm.

Miguel (Legal): I'll review. Quick note  in DE/FR we should require a written expected duration when remote > 10 business days. I'll add suggested wording.

Yuki (Localization): Happy to translate. Prefer we avoid slang like "flex credits" or "comp days" so translations stay tight.

Rory: I can own the tracker + automations. What CSV schema do we need? Also will set up nightly S3 export.

Cam (People Ops): CSV header (exact order):
```csv
manager_name,team,email,attested(yes/no),attestation_ts,training_session,verifier,notes
```
Please include email so the system can auto-send PDF receipts. We rely on exact ordering for the nightly export.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled  RSVP ping 9 days before first drop-in and completion nudge 3 days before publish date.

Rory: I'll seed the sheet with managers from Eng and Product and add a column for "pre-seeded" so we know who was invited automatically. I'll wire an automation to email a PDF ack to the email column when the row is marked attested=yes. Also will push nightly CSV to s3://company-compliance/handbook-attestations.

Miguel (Legal): Reviewing now  added a short clause for DE/FR and clarified contractor language. No blockers otherwise.

Zara: Wording pass done  tightened the approval flow and added an example for on-call shift swaps. Kept text under 250 words.

Yuki (Localization): Will localize strings after you freeze. I can turn around FR/DE/ES in 48 hours.

Cam (People Ops): Awesome. Action items: 1) Zara finalize wording today; 2) Miguel finalize legal comments by 2026-05-20; 3) Rory build tracker + automations and nightly S3 export by 2026-05-23; 4) Yuki translate after freeze; 5) Cam publish 2026-06-01 and run two 20-min drop-ins (2026-05-26 & 2026-05-29). I'll post the PR link here when opened.

Rory: I'll also instrument a small reminder workflow for managers who don't mark attestation within 7 days of RSVP.

Cam (People Ops): PR opened: https://git.company/handbook/policies/attestation-schedule-exceptions-2026  please add quick reviews. Thanks everyone! :tada:
